> **NOTE:** This mod only works with the base map (SR / Modern). It is not recommended to use this mod in Classic mode, as it will cause the game to crash.

### Overview

An alternative version of my custom Dota 2 Lane Creeps mod based on the Cavernite Creeps from The International 2018

You can also preview the original [Dota 2 Lane Creeps](https://runeforge.dev/mods/ec753ec0-385c-4bac-a4b5-7894c03ee303) mod

---

### Differences

Replaced Melee and Ranged minions on both sides
